study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. TTP reported as baseline characteristic comparing empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin groups (median 20.2h vs 18.5h, p=0.02). Mortality reported but not stratified by TTP nor modeled against TTP. Expanded cohort overlapping with Wong2016_a (n=255); recommend retaining Wong2016_b (n=400) in final pool. Single reviewer for data extraction. Two tertiary hospitals in Vancouver, BC.

population.empiric_abx_definition: Empiric = first dose of antibiotic at/after first positive blood culture; definitive = cloxacillin or cefazolin once susceptibilities known. Both arms received definitive cloxacillin/cefazolin per inclusion criteria.
population.notes: Adult inpatients with first episode of MSSA bacteremia at 2 Vancouver tertiary hospitals 2007-2014. n=400 (200 empiric beta-lactam, 200 empiric vancomycin). 82.8% community-onset. Charlson median 3-4. Infective endocarditis 17.0% overall. Age means by arm: beta-lactam 53.0+/-16.9, vancomycin 57.9+/-18.4. Males by arm 63.0% vs 66.0%.

ttp.notes: TTP reported by empiric treatment arm only (baseline characteristic): beta-lactam median 20.2h (IQR 16.6-25.5) vs vancomycin median 18.5h (IQR 16.2-23.3), p=0.02. No pooled cohort TTP statistics; no TTP-vs-mortality model. Cutpoint not applicable.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 28-day all-cause in-hospital mortality 34/400 (8.5%); by arm: beta-lactam 16/200 (8.0%) vs vancomycin 18/200 (9.0%), p=0.72. Not stratified by TTP.
outcomes.adjustment_vars: age; sex; age-adjusted Charlson comorbidity index; Pitt bacteremia score; ID consultation; infective endocarditis; time to receipt of empiric antibiotics
outcomes.notes: Adjusted OR is for empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin (treatment exposure), NOT TTP.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 90-day all-cause in-hospital mortality 57/400 (14.3%); by arm: beta-lactam 25/200 (12.5%) vs vancomycin 32/200 (16.0%), p=0.32. Not stratified by TTP.
Recurrent MSSA bacteremia within 6 months after treatment completion; 15/400 (3.75%); beta-lactam 7/200 (3.5%) vs vancomycin 8/200 (4.0%), p=0.79.
Duration of bacteremia >=3 days (proportion); beta-lactam 98/182 (53.8%) vs vancomycin 111/185 (60.0%), p=0.25. Median duration overall ~80h.
outcomes.notes: Persistent bacteremia by arm; not by TTP.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. 1:1 matched case-control of candidemia vs non-candidemia bacteremia at single Yunnan tertiary hospital. TTP modeled as binary >=2d vs <2d to predict candidemia status (OR 121.03), NOT mortality. 60-day mortality reported by candidemia subgroup but no TTP-vs-mortality regression. Mortality effect captured here is candidemia-vs-non-candidemia (exposure surrogate). Article-in-press unedited manuscript.

population.pathogen_species: Candida spp. (candidemia cases, n=67) matched 1:1 to non-candidemia bacteremia controls (n=67)
population.notes: 134 total = 67 candidemia + 67 matched non-candidemia controls. Candidemia age 65.22+/-22.85, non-candidemia 67.39+/-17.30 (NS). Males 87/134 (64.9%). >64y old 61.2% in each group. Common infection sources/site infections: pulmonary 41.8%, septic shock 21.6%, UTI 19.4%, abdominal 5.2%.

ttp.notes: TTP reported in DAYS in source (overall 1.82+/-1.18 d; candidemia 2.52+/-1.30 d; non-candidemia 1.12+/-0.37 d). Converted to hours by x24: overall mean 43.68+/-28.32h; candidemia 60.5+/-31.2h; non-candidemia 26.9+/-8.9h, p<0.001. Categorical: <3d (n=104, candidemia 38 + non-candidemia 66), 3-5d (n=23, candidemia 22 + non-candidemia 1), >5d (n=7, candidemia 7 + non-candidemia 0). Cutpoint analyzed = >=2d (~48h) yielding OR 121.03 (97.5%CI 22.61-647.95) for candidemia (NOT mortality). n_short_ttp/n_long_ttp here use the <3d/>=3d split (most granular reported). Cutpoint basis = clinical convention used by paper.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 60-day all-cause mortality after admission. Overall 23/134 (17.2%). Stratified by exposure (candidemia status, which correlates with TTP): candidemia 21/67 (31.34%) vs non-candidemia 2/67 (2.99%), p<0.05. Median survival of dead candidemia patients 14.5 days.
outcomes.notes: events_short/long_ttp computed as a descriptive 2x2 using candidemia (longer TTP, mean 60.5h) vs non-candidemia (shorter TTP, mean 26.9h) as the TTP-surrogate exposure. Crude OR computed by extractor = (21*65)/(46*2) ~ 14.8 with continuity correction ~ 10.5; CIs not reported by paper for this contrast. Paper reports the categorical TTP comparison (>=2d) as a predictor of candidemia not death, OR 121.03. No adjusted mortality model.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. TTP recorded only in DAYS (not hours), limiting granularity. TTP comparison is bacteremia-vs-contamination (microbiology classification), not TTP-vs-mortality. Mortality reported as descriptive 3/27 (or 4/27 per abstract) in the bacteremia group receiving appropriate therapy; no formal TTP-mortality model. Funding: this research did not receive any specific grant. Final bacteremia/contamination decision by author panel (potential subjectivity).

population.pathogen_species: Corynebacterium spp. (C. striatum n=38, C. jeikeium n=6, C. argentoratense n=2, Corynebacterium sp. n=19); 28 classified bacteremia, 35 contamination
population.empiric_abx_definition: Appropriate = treatment regimen with one or more antibiotics shown active in vitro per CLSI breakpoints
population.notes: Single 1037-bed teaching hospital (Nihon University Itabashi Hospital, Tokyo). 63 adults with positive blood cultures for Corynebacterium spp. Bacteremia subgroup (n=28): age median 65.5 (IQR 57.3-77), 22/28 male (78.6%), CVC in 21/28 (75%), peripheral cath 4/28 (14%). Source of bacteremia: intravenous catheter in 20/28 (71%). 27/28 received appropriate antibiotics (1 died before final report).

ttp.notes: TTP reported only in days. Overall median 1 day (IQR 1-2); bacteremia 1d (IQR 1-1) vs contamination 2d (IQR 1-2), p=0.009. All bacteremia cases TTP<=3 days. Converted to hours by x24 (median 24h, IQR 24-48h, max 72h for bacteremia). Granularity limited.

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital death due to Corynebacterium bacteremia. Of 27 patients in bacteremia group receiving appropriate antimicrobial therapy: 24 cured, 3 died (11.1%). Abstract reports 4/27 died (one died before final report = 4/28 = 14.3% total in bacteremia group). Not stratified by TTP.
outcomes.notes: Descriptive only; in-hospital mortality 3-4/27-28 (~11-14%) in bacteremia subgroup with appropriate therapy. No TTP stratification.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. TTP reported by AmpC/non-AmpC subgroups (8.33+/-2.18h vs 9.48+/-3.82h, p=0.006) and proposed cutoff <8.16h for AmpC prediction (sens 71.9%, spec 62.2%, NPV 93.1%). TTP NOT modeled as direct predictor of mortality. Multivariable mortality model identified metastasis, septic shock, organ failure as independent predictors; AmpC NOT independently associated with mortality though crude mortality higher (25.5% vs 12.2%, p=0.018). Public funding (National Natural Science Foundation of China).

population.pathogen_species: Escherichia coli (51 AmpC-EC, 197 non-AmpC-EC); ESBL-producing strains excluded
population.empiric_abx_definition: Adequate AAT = regimen with one or more antibiotics active in vitro at appropriate doses
population.incubation_protocol: BACTEC FX400 with plus aerobic/F and anaerobic lytic/10 bottles incubated at 35C for at least 5 days
population.notes: Single Tianjin tertiary cancer center (2400 beds). 248 hospitalized adult cancer patients with E. coli bacteremia. Sources: biliary 51 (20.6%), abdominal abscess 39 (15.7%), unknown 67 (27.0%), UTI 24 (9.7%), pulmonary 28 (11.3%), catheter-related 13 (5.2%). 30/248 ICU stay (12.1%). Mean LOS 30.7d. Approx 50% male; AmpC subgroup 62.7% male vs non-AmpC 46.7%.

ttp.notes: TTP defined as time from start of incubation to alert signal. Mean TTP by subgroup: AmpC-EC 8.33+/-2.18h vs non-AmpC-EC 9.48+/-3.82h, p=0.006. ROC-derived cutoff <8.16h proposed for predicting AmpC-EC (sens 71.9%, spec 62.2%, NPV 93.1%). No overall cohort TTP mean reported. Cutoff applied to predict AmpC status (microbiology) NOT mortality. n_short/long_ttp not directly tabulated.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 30-day all-cause mortality overall 62/248 (25.0%). By AmpC subgroup (TTP-surrogate): AmpC-EC 13/51 (25.5%, shorter TTP mean 8.33h) vs non-AmpC-EC 24/197 (12.2%, longer TTP mean 9.48h), p=0.018.
outcomes.notes: Descriptive 2x2 using AmpC vs non-AmpC as TTP-surrogate (AmpC=shorter TTP). Crude OR by extractor = (13*173)/(38*24) ~ 2.46. CIs not reported by paper for this contrast. AmpC was NOT an independent mortality predictor in multivariable model (independents: metastasis OR 2.78, septic shock OR 4.98, organ failure OR 24.51). No direct TTP-vs-mortality model.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. TTP reported by Candida species (mean+/-SD in hours) and mortality reported by species; no direct TTP-vs-mortality regression. Multivariable mortality predictors identified were BMI, hypoproteinemia, broad-spectrum antibiotic use/duration, PN, G+ coccemia, elder age, GI/urinary surgery. Note C. tropicalis paradox: shortest TTP (22.16h) AND highest mortality (41.7%). Single Beijing hospital (BTCH). Small sample (n=94).

population.pathogen_species: Candida spp.: C. albicans 44 (46.8%), C. parapsilosis 22 (23.4%), C. glabrata 16 (17.0%), C. tropicalis 12 (12.8%)
population.empiric_abx_definition: Antifungal treatment with triazoles (fluconazole/voriconazole), echinocandins (caspofungin), or amphotericin B per CLSI M27 (2017) susceptibility
population.incubation_protocol: Bruker Microflex LT/SH automated system; positive samples to blood agar/Sabouraud/modified Shadomy/CHROMagar at 35C for 48-72h; instrument 5d no-alarm = negative
population.notes: Beijing Tsinghua Changgung Hospital (BTCH). 94 adult candidemia patients. 59 male, 35 female. 22/94 (23.4%) died (in-hospital/28-day). 41/94 (43.6%) ICU. 20/94 (21.3%) CVC. Underlying malignancy 37 (39.4%). Diabetes 19 (20.2%). 30/94 (31.9%) had G+ coccemia in 10 days prior. Inclusion: age >=18, complete data, single-species blood culture. Exclusions: prior antifungals in 1mo, polymicrobial, no clearance.

ttp.notes: TTP = time from incubation start to positive alert. Overall mean 38.44+/-2.14h. By species: C. albicans 45.16+/-3.34h, C. parapsilosis 33.18+/-3.82h, C. glabrata 39.56+/-5.04h, C. tropicalis 22.16+/-3.80h (F=5.03, p<0.01). SD values appear to be SEM. No cutpoint analyzed. No TTP-vs-mortality model.

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital / 28-day all-cause mortality: 22/94 (23.4%) overall. By species: C. albicans 10/44 (22.7%), C. parapsilosis 5/22 (22.7%), C. glabrata 2/16 (12.5%), C. tropicalis 5/12 (41.7%). No significant species difference (chi-sq=3.31, p=0.34).
outcomes.notes: Descriptive 2x2 using C. tropicalis (shortest TTP 22.16h) as 'short_ttp' and C. albicans (longest TTP 45.16h) as 'long_ttp'. Crude OR = (5*34)/(7*10) ~ 2.43. Paradoxical: short TTP correlates with HIGHER mortality (C. tropicalis). Mortality NOT directly modeled against TTP; multivariable predictors were BMI, hypoproteinemia, broad-spec abx, PN, G+ coccemia, elder, GI/urinary surgery.
